sections.heading: style-118 — Thermal Silhouette Imaging · 3 s silent preview

children.value: Subject: an idea becomes a connected system. 1280×720, 30 fps, 3 s, silent. Background: opaque #080808 throughout.

Style renderer: Three.js WebGLRenderer + GLSL ShaderMaterial (fullscreen orthographic quad, vendored three.min.js, scene script inline in index.html). Load-time helpers: Canvas 2D masks (head profile + ear, network wires) and a chroma.js LAB ramp #080808 → #C82E20 → #F07C30 → #FFF1D5.
Motion engine: GSAP. One paused timeline
tweens the uniform-state object; onUpdate writes the uniforms and calls renderer.render, and hf-seek also seeks and redraws.

rows.Beat: Dark head silhouette, barely warm, on black. Title "AN IDEA HEATS UP" fades up.
Head warms black → red → orange; the core heats faster than the edges, and the nose and ear stay cooler. Subtitle and the "ILLUSTRATIVE HEAT · NOT MEASURED DATA" disclaimer appear.
The idea hotspot near the brow ignites to cream.
Heat runs out along the wires into the network, cooling with distance.
Three node hotspots switch on one after another (hard-edged discs with cream cores).
Shimmer fades out and the frame settles and holds.

children.value: There are no arrows and no containers with internal labels; all text is standalone copy. There is no temperature legend because the heat is illustrative.
